title: Photo and panel
description: An edge-to-edge photo on one side and, on a coloured panel, a label, a headline, a short text and a button, with an optional note beside it. For the yard, an open day or any invitation.

text.default: Two railway arches where Sean makes the staircases and we keep reclaimed brick and limestone. Come and handle the finishes before you choose them, and bring the kids if you like. Nelson, the yard dog, will want to say hello.
